title: A 5500-year-old Treponema pallidum genome from Sabana de Bogotá, Colombia | Science
content: Treponematosis, a bacterial infection caused by Treponema pallidum subspecies and T. carateum (yaws, bejel, syphilis, pinta), has afflicted humans for millennia. Despite paleopathological evidence and emerging genomic data, little is known about the ...
